lines.text: In January, it was a small tree in a pot, resting by a cold window.
lines.sub:
In January, it was a small tree in a pot,
resting by a cold window.

lines.text: By April, twenty-three flowers. The whole room smelled sweet.
lines.sub:
By April, 23 flowers.
The whole room smelled sweet.

lines.text: And in June, it let almost all of them go.
lines.sub:
And in June,
it let almost all of them go.

lines.text: Gardeners call it the June drop. A tree keeps only what it can carry.
lines.sub:
Gardeners call it the June drop.
A tree keeps only what it can carry.

lines.text: When the nights turned cold, it slowly turned gold.
lines.sub:
When the nights turned cold,
it slowly turned gold.
